> **Development build:** expect bugs.

- **More natural rock surfaces:** cliff highlights now have finer, more varied roughness, while limestone road cuts have deeper-looking detail and less shine in dark crevices.
- **Better cliff outcrops:** larger rocks have sharper surface detail, blend more closely with the cliff color, and sit more naturally in rugged areas, with smaller rocks scattered around them.
- **Better scenery loading:** cliff transition strips and rocks wait for the surrounding terrain, reducing floating scenery as new areas load.
- **Smoother cliff-heavy drives:** rock loading is spread across frames, and the server limits some cliff data kept in memory and frees cached data when system memory runs low. Heavy areas can still stutter.

**To play:** download the Windows `.exe` or Linux `.AppImage` below. With Steam running, launch the downloaded app, then select **Freeroam > BeamNG.Earth**. Keep the app open while playing.
